description: Fork of exp263 with uncertainty_T_init=0.5 (matches soft mode's soft_score_temp=0.5 default). exp263 at T_init=1.0 showed the optimizer drifting T down (qk L0 reached 0.85 by step 1000) and was running +0.01 bpb behind exp262 — suggesting init=1 was too high. Starting at 0.5 lets the optimizer explore the small-T regime from the start. β fixed at 0.5. Comparators: exp262=1.6148 (fixed T=1), exp263 (killed at step 1400, T_init=1, drifting down), exp257=1.6060 (soft+noise target).
